name: Seated knee extension
summary: Sitting, straighten one knee until the leg is level, hold, and lower — the seated banded kick.
setup: Sit tall on a chair, side-on to the phone, working leg nearest. Straighten the knee until the leg is horizontal, pause with the thigh tight, then lower slowly. With a band, loop it around the working ankle and anchor it behind the chair.
brief: Sit tall on the chair. Straighten the working knee until the leg is horizontal, pause with the thigh tight, then lower slowly.
why: Side-on the knee angle runs from about 90° to straight, which counts the rep, and the pause at the top has to be held for it to count as a full one. Leaning back to help shows as the shoulder–hip line tipping away from upright, and the thigh coming off the seat shows as the hip–knee line tipping up.

progress.overTip: Locking hard into the end range loads the kneecap; stop where the leg is level.

tempo: Up 2 s, hold 2 s, down 3 s.
progression: Ankle weight; longer hold at the top.
regression: Part range, or stop short of straight if it clicks.
contraindications: Sharp pain under the kneecap near full straightening.

faults.label: Leaning back to help
faults.tip: Leaning back lets the hip flexors join in. Keep the trunk upright and the thigh on the seat.

faults.label: Thigh lifting off the seat
faults.tip: A thigh that lifts turns this into a hip lift. Sit heavy and move only the shin.

faults.label: No pause at the top
faults.cue: Hold two seconds at the top
faults.tip: The pause with the leg level is where the quad works hardest. A rep without it counts as a partial.

faults.label: Not reaching the target
faults.tip: Take each rep through the full range you set — half reps count as partials.

faults.label: Too fast
faults.tip: Control both directions; momentum takes the work away from the muscle.

faults.label: Letting the leg drop
faults.tip: The lowering builds the muscle. Three seconds down, every rep.

faults.label: Gripping the seat
faults.tip: Pulling on the chair braces the whole body and takes load off the thigh.

guide.surface: A chair high enough that the feet hang or just touch.
guide.stop: Kneecap pain, or the knee locking with a clunk.
guide.cannotSee: How fast the leg is lowered on its own, whether the hands are pulling on the seat, and how hard the band is pulling.

points.t: Straightens until the shin is level; toes pulled up.
Held there for two seconds — a rep without the pause is a partial.
Stays down on the seat; the hip–knee line tipping up is the thigh lifting.
Upright; the shoulders tipping back behind the hips is leaning back to help.
Hands resting on the seat edge, not gripping.
Up 2 s, hold 2 s, down 3 s.

calibrationPose: Sit tall with both feet hanging, hands resting on the seat.
